title: Schematify replaces Forger and Journeyman as one unified application
context: HELVE Forger held the technical design graph and HELVE Journeyman held the product layer as separate applications with separate UIs and data stores.
decision: Merge both applications into a single Schematify application that holds both the technical design graph and the product layer (screens, flows, briefs) within one interface.
consequences: Single codebase to maintain but requires unified data model and UI; retirement of the Forger and Journeyman names across all product surfaces and documentation; increased scope of the single application.
